crossRefs.note: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
“I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…
Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since…
Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain,
A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be…
But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see…

translations.web: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
translations.bsb: Why should the fool have money in his hand with no intention of buying wisdom?
translations.kjv: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart
translations.asv: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, Seeing he hath no understanding?
